"""Maximal bounded request: 131072 puts, 131072 query addresses, 3 saves, 16 loads."""
import json, random, sys, os, time, subprocess

def build(seed=3, npref=8192):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    pref = []
    seen = set()
    while len(pref) < npref:
        ln = rng.choice([0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,12,13,16,17,23,24,47,48,53,58,59,64,65,66,71,76,
                         83,88,95,100,107,112,119,124,125,126,127,128])
        v = rng.getrandbits(ln) if ln else 0
        p = '%032x' % v
        if (p, ln) in seen: continue
        seen.add((p, ln)); pref.append((p, ln))
    ops = []
    for i in range(131072):
        p, ln = pref[rng.randrange(len(pref))]
        ops.append(['put', p, ln, rng.randint(0, 4194302)])
    addrs = ['%032x' % rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(65536)]
    for (p, ln) in pref[:65536]:
        v = int(p, 16) | (1 << (127 if ln == 0 else rng.randrange(max(1, ln), 128)))
        addrs.append('%032x' % v)
    ops.append(['save'])
    ops.append(['load_saved', 0])
    ops.append(['query', addrs[:65536]])
    ops.append(['image_query', addrs[65536:]])
    ops.append(['save']); ops.append(['load_saved', 1])
    ops.append(['save']); ops.append(['load_saved', 2])
    return {"cases": [{"ops": ops}]}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    req = build()
    body = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
    print('request bytes', len(body), 'ops', len(req['cases'][0]['ops']))
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run.py'], input=body.encode(), cwd='/workspace',
                       capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    print('elapsed %.2fs rc=%d stderr=%s' % (dt, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:300]))
    if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(1)
    resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    res = resp['results'][0]
    print('answers', len(res['answers']), 'loads', res['loads'])
    print('cells', res['snapshots'][0]['cells'])
    print('rows', sum(len(b) for b in res['snapshots'][0]['banks']))
PY
